title: The Washed-Out Crossing
subtitle: Academy Readiness Evaluation
purpose: Prototype the illustrated STEM Nation mission experience before wiring it into the full student flow.
student_goal: Choose only three survival priorities, explain why they matter, and test the plan.

materials.label: Rope
materials.student_prompt: Why might rope matter after a crossing washes out?

materials.label: Wood Planks
materials.student_prompt: Why might planks matter for crossing or shelter?

materials.label: Medicine
materials.student_prompt: Why might medicine become urgent after flooding?

materials.label: Food
materials.student_prompt: Why might food matter if travel is delayed?

materials.label: Map
materials.student_prompt: Why might a map matter before moving people?

materials.label: Lantern
materials.student_prompt: Why might light matter near damaged water routes?

checkpoint_language.start: Observe the scene before choosing materials.
checkpoint_language.selecting: Choose only three priorities. The order matters.
checkpoint_language.explaining: Now explain why each choice matters.
checkpoint_language.ready_to_test: Your plan is ready to test.
checkpoint_language.complete: Mission checkpoint complete. You defended your survival priorities.

advisor_dialogue.intro: The crossing is unstable. Before we move anyone, we need to decide what matters first.
advisor_dialogue.selecting: Choose carefully. Only three priorities can guide this first survival plan.
advisor_dialogue.limit_warning: Only three priorities. A leader must decide what matters most when everything feels urgent.
advisor_dialogue.explain: Now defend your choices. Why do these priorities belong in your top three?
advisor_dialogue.missing_reason: A choice without a reason is not ready for the Council. Explain each priority.
advisor_dialogue.complete: Checkpoint complete. You selected, explained, and defended your survival priorities.

start_mode.opening_instruction: Review the incident, then begin when you are ready.
